answer_1.quote: We propose a two-stage method for differentially private utterance synthesis that exploits the inherent structure in the parse trees to better fit the private distribution.
answer_1.outputs: Synthesized user utterances (text) for inspection and annotation

answer_2.quote: We report two sets of metrics here: (1) Language and (2) Parse metrics. Language metrics (MAUVE and word overlap) are measured from the generated utterances themselves, whereas parse metrics (chi-square distance and function overlap) are measured from parse trees corresponding to the synthesized utterances.
